We need to determine how many gallons to add to reach full capacity. But we don't know current gallons. We have 10 liters. Convert liters to gallons: 1 liter = 0.264172 gallons. So 10 liters = 2.64172 gallons. Tank capacity 50 gallons. So need to add 47.35828 gallons. But maybe we just fill to capacity: we can call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount = 50 - current gallons. But we don't know current gallons. We can approximate: 10 liters ~ 2.64 gallons. So need ~47.36 gallons. Let's call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 47.36.
